messages:
hana: Quick design question — posted an updated mock with a compact scrubber that shows sampled vs full timeline previews. Trying to make p95 spikes less confusing when sampling is enabled. PTAL: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz :eyes:

jon: Nice, saw the gif. The teal/orange contrast is subtle — problematic for colorblind users. Could we add a non-color affordance? :pray:

hana: Yup — thinking pattern overlays for sampled buckets + revising palette. Example CSS I tried: `background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.03) 0 3px, transparent 3px 6px);`

sam: Pattern overlays sound good. Also UX copy: 'Live' vs 'Aggregate' is confusing. Suggest badges like `Live stream` and `Aggregated (5m)` — shorter and clearer in the toolbar.

li: UX nit: scrubber handle hit target is tiny on touch. Make the draggable area min 44px. When sampling is on, the hover tooltip should say `Sampled window: 1/10 reqs` instead of just a raw count, so it's clearer what the numbers mean.

arik: For p95 annotation, instead of a floating modal, try an inline dotted guide line with a tiny chip `p95 · 320ms` pinned to the left axis. Less obstructive and better for scanning. :thumbsup:

design-bot: Accessibility check run — text contrast OK, but sampled/original color pair fails color-difference heuristics. Recommend pattern + bump delta L by 10%.

hana: Plan from this thread: (1) swap to pattern+color palette, (2) bump scrubber touch target to 44px, (3) change badges to `Live stream` / `Aggregated (5m)`, (4) inline p95 chip + dotted line, (5) add a small 'Preview raw' toggle near timepicker. I'll upload v2 later today.

jon: One more product suggestion — provide an 'instant preview' toggle that shows raw (unsampled) points temporarily without changing global sampling config. Small CTA next to the timepicker would work.

hana: Good call. I'll mock a tiny toggle `Preview raw` that overlays unsampled points for the duration of the preview (non-destructive).

sam: Accessibility follow-up — ensure toggling preview announces changes via an aria-live region so screen readers pick up the chart update.

li: Also: legend ordering is inverted vs drawing order right now — that trips users when scanning. Make legend match the stack top-to-bottom.

hana: Noted — will flip legend order and align layout with drawing order. Uploading iteration 2 in a few hours. Thanks everyone!

jon: Thanks! :rocket:
